availability.invalidUrl: Enter a site address, for example youtube.com.
availability.unsupportedScheme: Only http:// and https:// links are supported.

rec.reachableWithoutVpn: Your provider does not block the site (the network works). If the site still fails or says “Not supported in your country”, it refuses your IP itself — turn the VPN on.
rec.refusedVpnNotMeasured: The site answers but requires sign-in or refuses your IP — availability is not confirmed. The VPN path has not been measured yet — turn the VPN on and check again.
rec.directFailedVpnNotMeasured: Direct access fails, but the VPN path has not been measured yet. Turn the VPN on and check again.
rec.pathNotMeasured: The path without VPN was not measured, so the two cannot be compared. Check again.
rec.geoBlockedLocally: The site itself refuses access from your region (content “not available in your country”), although the network does not block it. It opens through the VPN — keep protection on.
rec.geoBlockedVpnCountry: The site also blocks the VPN server's country. Try a server in another country (not the current one).
rec.refusedWithoutVpn: The site itself refuses access without the VPN (it returns access error 403). Keep protection on.
rec.refusedThroughVpn: The site refuses access through the VPN (access error 401/403) but opens directly. Add it to the exceptions or pick a server in another country.
rec.authRequired: The site answers but requires sign-in or refuses your IP — availability is not confirmed.
rec.reachableBoth: Your provider does not block the site (the network works). If the site still fails or says “Not supported in your country”, it refuses Russian visitors itself — turn the VPN on in that case.
rec.providerBlocks: The site works only through the VPN — your provider blocks it directly. Keep protection on.
rec.onlyWithVpn: The site works only through the VPN: without it there is no proper answer. Keep protection on.
rec.onlyWithoutVpn: The site works only without the VPN (typical of Russian services). Add it to the exceptions or turn protection off for a while.
rec.blockedEverywhere: The site answers neither through the VPN nor directly. It may be down or blocked by content (not by network) — try another server.
rec.incomplete: The check could not be completed.

fail.legal: The site answered 451 (blocked for legal reasons / geo-block).
fail.geoBlock: The site loaded but refused access for your region (geo-block).
fail.dnsSuspect: DNS returned a suspicious IP ({{ips}}) — DNS spoofing suspected.
fail.dns: The name does not resolve to an IP.
fail.tcp: The TCP connection did not open.
fail.tls: The TLS handshake failed. SNI-based DPI blocking is possible.
fail.httpStatus: The HTTP request got no meaningful answer: status {{status}}.
fail.http: The HTTP request got no meaningful answer.

error.closed: the remote side closed the connection
error.tlsCertName: the name does not match the certificate
error.proxyFailed: the engine's direct exit is unavailable

http.authRequired: requires sign-in or refuses your IP

geo.shortPageMarker: block text on a short page
geo.longPageMarker: block mentioned on a long page (weak signal)
geo.foreignAlsoBlocked: the protected path did not get a normal page either
geo.localOnlyStubRedirect: redirect to a stub directly, not through the VPN
geo.localNearlyEmpty: full page through the VPN, almost empty directly
geo.localOnlyMarker: block marker directly but not through the VPN

speed.notConnected: Connect the VPN first — the speed test runs through the tunnel.
speed.serverChanged: The server changed during the test — the result was not saved.
speed.latencyFailed: Could not measure latency. Check your Internet connection and the VPN.
speed.downloadFailed: Could not measure download speed: every test server is unavailable.
speed.uploadNotMeasured: Upload speed could not be measured.

egress.match: The test traffic went through the VPN server.
egress.changed: The public IP differed from the VPN address during the test — the result may not belong to this server.
egress.direct: The test bypassed the VPN: the public IP matched your real address.
egress.notChecked: The exit to the Internet was not checked during the test.

warning.plainHttp: The HTTPS test servers are unavailable — speed was measured over unencrypted HTTP.
